title: Make moodboard add/place/connect affordances honest
origin: MT-044 D2 split: isolated moodboard canvas affordances silently no-op after FIX-2 isolation.

scope.summary: Ensure moodboard add/place/connect controls either round-trip into the moodboard snapshot or are hidden/disabled with visible Argus-readable status so no model sees silent no-op affordances.
base_scope: Ensure moodboard add/place/connect controls either round-trip into the moodboard snapshot or are hidden/disabled with visible Argus-readable status so no model sees silent no-op affordances.
acceptance_criteria: Moodboard add/place/connect affordances do not silently no-op.
If controls remain visible, their effects persist into the saved moodboard snapshot and reload path.
If controls are hidden/disabled, the UI and Argus readout explain why.
Existing moodboard move/geometry round-trip behavior remains intact.
risks_and_controls: Risk: enabling add/connect reintroduces the shared-canvas leak fixed by MT-012.
Risk: hiding controls reduces discoverability without clear status text.
verification: Focused Argus/UI proof for honest affordance behavior.

review_lenses: scope containment versus MT-044 tracker drift

handoff.note: MT-046 is ready for validator review. This is not official validation; validator_verdict remains PENDING. Moodboard canvas add/place/connect/group/remove host-backed affordances are hidden in snapshot-projection mode with Argus-readable status, registry host mutations are rejected, existing move round-trip is preserved, and image/shape resize remains supported while text resize is hidden because it does not round-trip.
implementation_summary: Added CanvasMutationPolicy::SnapshotProjection to distinguish host-backed Loom canvas behavior from CKC moodboard snapshot projection behavior.

Configured the CKC moodboard board as SnapshotProjection so unsupported add/place/connect/group/remove affordances are hidden and blocked registry actions report an honest status instead of silently no-oping.
Kept existing moodboard move round-trip behavior and retained image/shape resize only; hid text-card resize because reverse projection persists text position but not text box size.
Updated the internal UserManual/Argus guidance to describe move-existing plus image/shape-resize-only moodboard persistence.
